records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account is engaged: first project reached 9/03, one invite sent (slack:bf5cfe0f), and Maya replied positively on 9/08 (email:72452a12) with no blockers or tickets. But key_milestone still unreached at day 6 and she deferred the walkthrough vaguely, so momentum is real but uncertain over the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the note -- glad things are going well, and happy to do that walkthrough whenever it's useful.

If you have 20 minutes this week, I'd be glad to look at how your Harbor Studio project is organized and talk through what you want to get out of Wrenfield next. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the most useful place to start. Just tell me a day that suits and I'll work around you.

Best,
Nadia
